name: Copper Hush
image_style: A striking 16:10 landscape wallpaper rendered as a large-scale photopolymer intaglio print with translucent aniline washes, blind embossing, fibrous rag paper, and occasional pearlescent mineral dust. Fine engraved linework describes brick, timber, soot, leather, and cast metal; broad washed shadows keep the image calm and tactile. The mood is nocturnal, industrious, antiquarian, and quietly comic, as if a serious technical document became a dream. Use deep petrol-black, bruised blue, smoked parchment, oxidized coral, muted celadon, and tiny brass highlights. Preserve a broad quiet upper edge for the desktop bar and a calm shadowed lower-left region for widgets. No lettering, logos, watermark, frame, border, or interface elements.
scene: Exactly one striking 16:10 landscape wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600, inside a historically grounded nineteenth-century bell foundry at blue hour. A long brick casting hall contains timber roof trusses, sand molds, clay cores, cooling channels, soot-dark brick, hanging ladles, iron tools, and workers in practical aprons examining a newly cast civic bell with serious craftsmanship. Through the open far doors, a misty river and slate rooftops recede beneath a broad quiet sky. In the lower-right, Space Ghost is unmistakable in his muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, standing rigidly beside the bell while pressing an enormous tuning fork against it as though conducting an official acoustic inspection. His cape is clipped safely away from the furnace, and the foundry workers continue their dignified work with restrained bewilderment. The humor comes only from his misplaced technical authority and impossible scale. Keep detail concentrated in the lower two-thirds, with the upper edge spacious and low-detail and the lower-left dark and calm for widgets. No sacred figures, devotional attributes, worship, text, lettering, logos, UI, watermark, or frame.
